annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that if the Pad Length field value (the number of padding octets) is equal to or exceeds the total length of the frame payload—including the Pad Length field itself—then a PROTOCOL_ERROR must be raised. The preceding clause clarifies that the Pad Length field is part of the frame payload, removing any ambiguity about what constitutes the frame payload length.
